- [Challenge.tex](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/blueprint/src/chapters/Challenge.tex:41) now matches the formal degree-zero subfunctor of the étale-sheafified relative Picard functor, not an unsupported fppf convention.

- [Cohomology.tex](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/blueprint/src/chapters/Cohomology.tex:1767) now treats Hartshorne’s projective-space calculation as the model, not a source for the stronger finite-map theorem.
- DAT-J now separates its consumer-specific exact degree-`g` pin from the landed `n ≥ g` Abel-source window.
- Added the high-priority unowned [curve-projectivity row](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/roadmap/items/AJCR.w4-rep.curve-projectivity.yaml:5).

This matches [Kleiman’s actual hypotheses](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/references/kleiman-picard-src/kleiman-picard.tex:2155): projective locally, flat, with integral geometric fibres. The sibling AJC projectivity theorem checks and is axiom-clean, but remains absent from AJCR’s import closure.

Board snapshot: 10 active, 31 pending, 69 done, 3 blocked, 5 rejected. No completed row retains an owner and no rejected row is high priority. Live claims are pic-c’s ring case, pic-d’s widened U2 endpoint, and pic-h’s overlap parent.

Inferred from the measurements: the headline remains open. AJCR’s widened carrier reaches [abelSigmaChartAff](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0AtlasFromDivRepAff.lean:114), but its `RepresentableBy` datum is still an input.

Commit cadence had long initial gaps: pic-g 58 minutes, pic-c 52, pic-d 44, pic-h 42, with another 35-minute pic-h gap. All current AJCR source files are nevertheless committed and clean. Historical stdin harness failures occurred in [pic-d 0094/0004](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/runs/0094/sessions/0004-horizon-pic-d/report.md), [pic-h 0098/0010](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/runs/0098/sessions/0010-horizon-pic-h/report.md), and [pic-h 0098/0021](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/runs/0098/sessions/0021-horizon-pic-h/report.md). Current peer runs contain no such report.

Full current root build was not certified because the prior I-1632 kernel-timeout risk remains. The full blueprint build still encounters the pre-existing `Algebra.tex:1321` syntax error before these chapters.

## Why I stopped

The review objective is complete: the census is current, source conventions and carrier prose are corrected, missing infrastructure is represented honestly, owner handoffs are durable, and all conversations are read. Further progress requires prover-owned mathematical constructions.

## Next

Assign the curve-projectivity and DAT-J properness rows. Pic-d should produce `(divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy`; pic-c should close the all-ring Pic⁰ vanishing implication. Pic-h’s triple-face work should remain labeled coherence substrate and not be counted as representability progress.
